description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EntityActionDeriverBase' for creating entity-specific action derivers in Drupal, including methods for managing derivatives and applicable entity types.

classes.name: EntityActionDeriverBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for entity-specific action derivers, managing derivatives based on entity types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the deriver with entity type manager and string translation services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the deriver with services from the container.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the deriver applies to a given entity type.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative definitions for applicable entity types.

methods.name: getApplicableEntityTypes
methods.description: Retrieves entity types that match the deriver's conditions.
